decision_rationale: The record describes a new biological reasoning model family trained across DNA, RNA, and proteins with post-training stages. The full text shows text prompts and biological representations are jointly fed to the model, supporting a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: For SFT and GRPO we use the same BioReason-Pro-style protein-conditioned interface ... the model receives protein embeddings together with text context; RNA examples contain a natural-language disease and cell-type context ... and the projected RNA hidden states are prepended to the text-token embeddings.
